ObjectInfoFlags.name: DEFAULT
ObjectInfoFlags.description: Initial value; resets all bits.

ObjectInfoFlags.description: Used within relphot; skip star.

ObjectInfoFlags.name: POOR
ObjectInfoFlags.description: Used within relphot; skip star.

ObjectInfoFlags.name: ICRF_QSO
ObjectInfoFlags.description: object IDed with known ICRF quasar (may have ICRF position measurement)

ObjectInfoFlags.name: HERN_QSO_P60
ObjectInfoFlags.description: identified as likely QSO (Hernitschek et al 2015), P_QSO >= 0.60

ObjectInfoFlags.name: HERN_QSO_P05
ObjectInfoFlags.description: identified as possible QSO (Hernitschek et al 2015), P_QSO >= 0.05

ObjectInfoFlags.name: HERN_RRL_P60
ObjectInfoFlags.description: identified as likely RR Lyra (Hernitschek et al 2015), P_RRLyra >= 0.60

ObjectInfoFlags.description: identified as possible RR Lyra (Hernitschek et al 2015), P_RRLyra >= 0.05

ObjectInfoFlags.name: HERN_VARIABLE
ObjectInfoFlags.description: identified as a variable based on ChiSq (Hernitschek et al 2015)

ObjectInfoFlags.name: TRANSIENT
ObjectInfoFlags.description: identified as a non-periodic (stationary) transient

ObjectInfoFlags.name: HAS_SOLSYS_DET
ObjectInfoFlags.description: at least one detection identified with a known solar-system object (asteroid or other).

ObjectInfoFlags.name: MOST_SOLSYS_DET

ObjectInfoFlags.name: LARGE_PM
ObjectInfoFlags.description: star with large proper motion

ObjectInfoFlags.name: RAW_AVE
ObjectInfoFlags.description: simple weighted average position was used (no IRLS fitting)

ObjectInfoFlags.name: FIT_AVE
ObjectInfoFlags.description: average position was fitted

ObjectInfoFlags.name: FIT_PM
ObjectInfoFlags.description: proper motion model was fitted

ObjectInfoFlags.name: FIT_PAR
ObjectInfoFlags.description: parallax model was fitted

ObjectInfoFlags.name: USE_AVE
ObjectInfoFlags.description: average position used (not PM or PAR)

ObjectInfoFlags.name: USE_PM
ObjectInfoFlags.description: proper motion used (not AVE or PAR)

ObjectInfoFlags.name: USE_PAR
ObjectInfoFlags.description: parallax used (not AVE or PM)

ObjectInfoFlags.name: NO_MEAN_ASTROM
ObjectInfoFlags.description: mean astrometry could not be measured

ObjectInfoFlags.name: STACK_FOR_MEAN
ObjectInfoFlags.description: stack position used for mean astrometry

ObjectInfoFlags.name: MEAN_FOR_STACK
ObjectInfoFlags.description: mean astrometry used for stack position

ObjectInfoFlags.name: BAD_PM
ObjectInfoFlags.description: failure to measure proper-motion model

ObjectInfoFlags.name: EXT
ObjectInfoFlags.description: extended in our data (eg, PS)

ObjectInfoFlags.name: EXT_ALT
ObjectInfoFlags.description: extended in external data (eg, 2MASS)

ObjectInfoFlags.name: GOOD
ObjectInfoFlags.description: good-quality measurement in our data (eg,PS)

ObjectInfoFlags.name: GOOD_ALT
ObjectInfoFlags.description: good-quality measurement in external data (eg, 2MASS)

ObjectInfoFlags.name: GOOD_STACK
ObjectInfoFlags.description: good-quality object in the stack (> 1 good stack measurement)

ObjectInfoFlags.name: BEST_STACK
ObjectInfoFlags.description: the primary stack measurements are the best measurements

ObjectInfoFlags.name: SUSPECT_STACK
ObjectInfoFlags.description: suspect object in the stack (no more than 1 good measurement, 2 or more suspect or good stack measurement)

ObjectInfoFlags.name: BAD_STACK
ObjectInfoFlags.description: poor-quality stack object (no more than 1 good or suspect measurement)
